positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Technical Lead, Aumni
Software Engineer, Technical Lead
positions.description:
As a mid level engineer at Aumni, I worked on various projects including our company’s data ingestion, customer facing audit tables, and user management. While overseeing squad projects, I became the technical leader and point person between our squad and product leadership. 

As a technical lead, I specialized in assessing project risk and lift. I identified blockers and strived to unblock engineers so that my squad delivered features continuously. I utilized team strengths to deliver impactful features to our clients.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Child company of JP Morgan. Acquired in 2023

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Remote Full Stack Software Engineer - Using technologies such as Docker, Angular, Node with NestJS, and Redis. 

Spear headed initial design and implementation of Microsoft Teams Integration with NetDocument’s Platform. 

Managed DevOps and Automation for our development and qa environments across multiple teams. DevOps - Kubernetes, Helm, AWS, Digital Ocean, and Azure
positions.insights: Skills: Full-Stack Development · JavaScript · Software Development · Version Control · C# · Computer Science · TypeScript · Node.js · End-to-end Testing · Web Development

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full stack software engineer - maintaining and building applications with React Typescript, Node/Express, and MongoDB. 

Primarily developed document software for the Minuteman III Missile program. Also, lead the development work on missile reliability software that predicted reliability of parts over time.

AWS Gov Cloud to host our stack via S3, Lambdas, and DocumentDB. Also using technologies such as AngularJS, C#, Odata, and SQL. Secret Security Clearance
